body:
I would do like the hits widgets does: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/widgets/hits/defaultTemplates.js

Mostly because we will be able to get rid of the mighty webpack loaders that are a pain to handle and bad for portability to our users (i.e. using require(instantsearch.js))

With templatestrings and regular js files you are good I think. Those templates are really small.
